changelog:
Initial release of Huangdi Health Timer.

- Provides 12 traditional Chinese medicine energy cycles, with meridian names and corresponding times.
- Delivers 3 unique, non-repeating health tips per cycle, using both JSON data and AI-generated variation.
- Supports default timezone Asia/Shanghai, with options for America/New_York and UTC.
- Available in both Chinese and English languages.
- Triggered by keywords such as "health", "养生", and "黄帝内经".
summary: Provides 12 traditional Chinese medicine energy cycles with three unique daily health tips in Chinese or English, default Asia/Shanghai timezone.
